description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot application class 'Application' that exposes a device connection service following the Hono API. It manages deployment of Verticles, handles service and authentication component setup, and registers health check providers.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main Spring Boot application class for device connection service, manages verticle deployment, service setup, and health checks.

methods.name: setServiceImplementation
methods.description: Sets the device connection service implementation, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: setAuthenticationService
methods.description: Sets the authentication service, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: deployRequiredVerticles
methods.description: Deploys the required verticles used by the application, including service and auth verticles.

methods.name: deployVerticle
methods.description: Deploys an individual verticle component if it implements Verticle, returning a future with the deployment ID.

methods.name: postDeploy
methods.description: Registers health check providers after deployment.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckProvider
methods.description: Registers the provided object as a health check provider if applicable.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to start the Spring Boot application.
